stage0044b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$敷島$$
「...It seems this capsule is
　some kind of cryo-sleep device」

stage0044b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$タケル$$
「It's a device that sleeps you without aging.
　In short, sleep in it and you won't age」

stage0044b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Then that kid inside the capsule...
　has been asleep since ages ago?」

stage0044b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$敷島$$
「That's right.
　Rock analysis nearby shows the capsule
　was buried 12,000 years ago」

stage0044b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「In human history terms, about when was that?」

stage0044b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$n
「The Stone Age.
　Naturally, Earth back then shouldn't have
　had the tech to build a capsule like that」

stage0044b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So that capsule really was made by aliens!」

stage0044b_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Dr. $$敷島$$...
　The capsule's lock will release shortly」

stage0044b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$敷島$$
「As expected of you, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$.
　Leaving the analysis to you paid off」

stage0044b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「No...
　I wasn't the one who released the lock」

stage0044b_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The cryo-sleep device had already begun
　thawing. Once that finished and the air was
　confirmed safe, the lock released itself」

stage0044b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Allow me to offer my view.
　That boy was likely put to sleep 12,000
　years ago, anticipating this very day」

stage0044b_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
???
「I already learned that much through sleep-learning」

stage0044b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$敷島$$
「Then you understand my words too?
　First, would you tell me your name?」

stage0044b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
???
「My name is... $$グーラ$$.
　That's all I remember」

stage0044b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Remember, $$グーラ$$.
　You were sent to this planet to live on,
　beyond the cycle of reincarnation」

stage0044b_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You are the one who shall rule that
　Earth... $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$」

stage0044b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I am... $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...!
　The prince who shall rule Earth!」

stage0044b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$タケル$$
「Is this... an illusion cast by the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!?」

stage0044b_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$グーラ$$
「It seems you've learned my father's power,
　Earthling」

stage0044b_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Him...!
　He was the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son!」

stage0044b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$ダンカン$$...
　Prepare a $$スペースロボ$$ for me」

stage0044b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop it, $$グーラ$$!
　You mustn't fight!!」

stage0044b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I won't take orders from you...!」

stage0044b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Futile, Earthlings.
　You've entered the Age of the Sun, and already
　walk the road to ruin」

stage0044b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Beyond the cycle of reincarnation, $$グーラ$$ shall
　rule this planet. Death awaits any who interfere」

stage0044b_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Sorry, $$正太郎$$...
　If I'd stopped $$グーラ$$, none of that
　would have happened...」

stage0044b_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's all right, $$セイミー$$.
　If $$グーラ$$ is our... Earth's enemy,
　I won't hesitate to fight」

stage0044b_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's my mission, since Father gave me $$鉄人$$...」

stage0044b_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$タケル$$
「Are you sure that's fine, $$正太郎$$?」

stage0044b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$タケル$$
「I don't want to see that sad face
　of yours... Tell me how you really feel」

stage0044b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Be honest, $$正太郎$$!
　You're too serious!」

stage0044b_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You don't really want to fight $$グーラ$$ either, right?」

stage0044b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Even if we're born on different planets,
　our hearts can still connect, right...」

stage0044b_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Watching $$正太郎$$ and the others,
　and $$タケル$$, don't you think so?」

stage0044b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$n
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ knew Mayan words...
　But I hear $$グーラ$$'s capsule was around
　12,000 years old...」

stage0044b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$n
「Just knowing of Mayan civilization was
　surprising, but $$グーラ$$'s father, the
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, has lived 12,000 years.」

stage0044b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$n
「The power of a black hole, and the
　fact he's lived through eons of time...」

stage0044b_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「The scale is fundamentally different
　from any enemy we've fought before.」

stage0044b_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$n
（And that phrase from the Mayan
　civilization... Why does he keep
　repeating that old doomsday prophecy...）

stage0044b_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text: ～ $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ Army $$巨大円盤$$ Bridge ～

stage0044b_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Welcome back, Your Highness $$グーラ$$.
　I offer my heartfelt congratulations
　on your awakening.」

stage0044b_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ロビー$$
「I am $$ロビー$$, an intelligence robot.
　Your father, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$,
　charged me to serve as your advisor.」

stage0044b_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I have heard of this, Your Highness.
　That Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ possesses a
　robot packed with all universal knowledge.」

stage0044b_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$グーラ$$
「So this is that $$ロビー$$.」

stage0044b_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ロビー$$
「It's a pleasure, Master
　$$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$.」

stage0044b_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Then answer my question, $$ロビー$$.
　Where is Father?」

stage0044b_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「The Father I knew wasn't that
　huge a form.」

stage0044b_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ロビー$$
「After putting Your Highness to sleep,
　your father became the incarnation
　of a black hole himself.」

stage0044b_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ロビー$$
「That is a mystery of the universe,
　one even I, $$ロビー$$, cannot fathom.」

stage0044b_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Your father can freely soar among
　the galaxy's stars, and send his
　shadow anywhere, as he did today.」

stage0044b_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ロビー$$
「And within that body,
　all the universe's truths have been drawn in」

stage0044b_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Indeed. Your father is the very
　demon king who reigns over the
　universe.」

stage0044b_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「And that father entrusted me with
　conquering Earth...」

stage0044b_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「What are your orders, Your Highness?」

stage0044b_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Today's battle convinced me.
　That $c is the greatest obstacle
　between my father and me.」

stage0044b_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I agree with you as well.」

stage0044b_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$グーラ$$
「First, I'll prepare. Then I'll challenge
　them to a decisive battle, and sweep away
　every obstacle to conquering Earth at once!」

stage0044b_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$グーラ$$
（Prepare yourself, $c.
　And you too, $$金田正太郎$$.）

stage0044b_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$グーラ$$
（I am $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...
　I swear on this name that I
　will defeat you.）

stage0044b_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Overcoming your own sorrow to give
　the boys courage, Master $$タケル$$...
　I've witnessed your galaxy-level love」

stage0044b_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The words that swayed Prince $$グーラ$$...
　If this $$ＡＧ$$ had a heart, I'd have wept」

stage0044b_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$タケル$$
「...Because I might have ended up
　just like $$グーラ$$ myself」

stage0044b_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$タケル$$
「Didn't I tell you...?
　That I was really sent from planet
　Gishin to become Earth's enemy...」

stage0044b_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$タケル$$
「But thanks to the parents and friends
　who raised me on Earth, I learned
　what it means to love」

stage0044b_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$タケル$$
「So I want to tell $$グーラ$$ what I've
　learned. If he still fights after that...」

stage0044b_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'll be the one to face him」

stage0044b_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood.
　So that resolve of yours birthed the Z-Chip」

stage0044b_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount... 150Z.
　I'll add it to the squad's stock」

stage0044b_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$タケル$$
「Keep this from $$正太郎$$ and $$ワッ太$$.
　I'd rather leave $$グーラ$$ to those two」

stage0044b_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood.
　I too wish to watch over the two boys'
　battle, alongside Master $$タケル$$」

stage0044b_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「About Prince $$グーラ$$...
　what do you think, Master $$マッキー$$?」

stage0044b_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$マッキー$$
「...I believe $$正太郎$$ will surely
　open $$グーラ$$'s heart」

stage0044b_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's not what I mean!
　Ugh, how frustrating!」

stage0044b_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Frankly, I'm asking which you like more,
　Master $$正太郎$$ or Prince $$グーラ$$!」

stage0044b_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Eh...?
　Asking me that so suddenly...」

stage0044b_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Which is it!? Come on, which is it!?
　A wavering heart is common enough,
　right? But two-timing is not allowed!」

stage0044b_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, answer me!
　Quick! Within two seconds!」

stage0044b_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, you!
　A mere servant robot, defying
　an agent robot!?」

stage0044b_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Phew... that helped.
　Thanks, Dad」

stage0044b_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$敷島$$
「But with $$ＡＧ$$ like that,
　guess D-Trader's closing up shop...」

stage0044b_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Then today, I'll mind the shop, just this once」

stage0044b_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Then let's get fired up today too... business, business!」
